---
title: "Create a single product listing"
description: "Step-by-step guide to the Add New Product screen: category, checklist, details, variations, images, and publish."
---

Open **Add New Product** from your vendor area. The page title is **Add New Product**; the short description explains you are adding a simple or variable product.

At the top you can use **← Back to Dashboard** or **Import Products** if you prefer the bulk workbook flow instead.

---

## 1. Product family and subcategory

This block is labeled **Product family and subcategory**.

- Use the **Search categories** field to find families and subcategories quickly, or browse the two columns: **Product family** (left) and **Subcategory** (right).
- You must select a subcategory before the rest of the form appears.

The notice at the top explains that **changing product family or subcategory will clear all data entered below**—finish your category choice before you invest time in the rest of the form.

---

## 2. What to include (checklist and listing strength)

After a subcategory is selected, you see the **choices** section with:

- A short note that **more complete listings rank higher in search results**.
- A **listing strength** bar (it updates as you select SKU-defining fields and add data).
- The instruction to **select the data you can provide** and that **at least one SKU** item is required. Open **Learn more** to see what the badges mean:
  - **SKU** — Defines separate product variations.
  - **Variant** — Additional detail for each variation.
  - **Shared** — Applies to all variations equally.

Fixed options you can turn on:

- **Brand**
- **Certifications** (info icon: selecting types enables document uploading later)
- **Country of Origin**
- **Data Tables** (info icon: enables upload options under **Documents & Assets**)
- **Documentation** (same)

Below that, lists load for your subcategory: items that create separate variations (SKU), shared fields for the whole family, optional extras, and per-variation detail (Variant). If something is missing for your product type, use **Contact us** at the bottom of that section.

---

## 3. Enter product details

### Title and description

- **Product Title** — Required, minimum six characters. Keep it short and descriptive. Do **not** put pricing, stock, warehouse location, or specification values in the title; those belong in the fields and variation rows below.
- **Description** — Required. Do not include personal contact details (email, phone, names); we regularly audit descriptions and such details will be removed, and we will potentially flag your listings.

### Stock location

- **Stock location – Country** — Required; search and pick a country.
- **City** — Optional; appears after you choose a country.

### Optional blocks (when checked above)

- **Brand** — Search and select; a logo may show when available.
- **Certification Type(s)** — Select all that apply; you will upload supporting files later. Helper text: **Select all applicable certification types. You will be asked to upload supporting documents after product images.**
- **Country of Origin** — Search and select when enabled.

Any **Shared** fields you enabled appear here once; fill them if they apply to every variation.

### Variation table (variable products)

When at least one **SKU** item is selected, a table appears for **variations**.

- The form reminds you to use **up to two decimal points without thousand separators** (examples show correct vs incorrect formats).
- If two rows repeat the same defining combination, you will see a warning: duplicate variations are not allowed—each row must be unique.
- Use **Add Variation Row** to add lines.
- Each row needs **Price**, **Stock**, and **Lead Time** (and any columns your subcategory requires). **Lead Time** is chosen from the allowed list in the dropdown.

---

## 4. Product images and Documents & Assets

### Product Images

Section heading: **Product Images**.

- At least one image is required.
- Limits (count and file size per image) are shown on the page.
- **The first image will be the featured image.**
- You can reorder images by dragging previews.

### Documents & Assets

This section heading is **Documents & Assets**. It only appears when you enabled **Data Tables**, **Documentation**, and/or **Certifications** in the checklist.

- You can upload up to **5 files per type** (Data Table / Spec Sheet, General Documentation, Certification), **15 files total**, **5MB per file**.
- Allowed types include common images, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, and text files.
- A line such as **Documentation 0/5, Data tables 0/5, Certifications 0/5** shows how many files you have used per type.

---

## 5. Publish

Scroll to the bottom of the form and choose **Publish Product**.

On success you see **Product Published Successfully**, a short confirmation, and:

- **Close** — Dismiss the message.
- **View Product** — Open the live product page in a new tab (when available).

You can use **← Back to Dashboard** at the top or bottom of the page anytime.
